name: Google Docs
label: Google Docs API v1
description: Google Docs API v1 via OfficialApiNode (nodes/google-docs/api_spec.json). Official Docs API v1 (docs.googleapis.com). Copy/export live on Drive API v3 — use the Google Drive node. Supply a minted OAuth access token (OfficialApiNode is bearer-only). Restricted user-data policy if public OAuth. Official docs: https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Google Docs official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'create', 'get', 'batch_update', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'create'.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `title` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: documentId
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `documentId` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: requests
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `requests` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: Include tabs
schema.description: documents.get includeTabsContent. get. true returns all tab contents.

schema.label: Suggestions view
schema.description: documents.get suggestionsViewMode. EXACT: DEFAULT_FOR_CURRENT_ACCESS | SUGGESTIONS_INLINE | PREVIEW_SUGGESTIONS_ACCEPTED | PREVIEW_WITHOUT_SUGGESTIONS.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: create, get, batch_update, listen. Default: create. Example: create.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Title
configurationParameters.description: Request field for operations that declare `title` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

configurationParameters.label: Suggestions view
configurationParameters.description: documents.get suggestionsViewMode. EXACT: DEFAULT_FOR_CURRENT_ACCESS | SUGGESTIONS_INLINE | PREVIEW_SUGGESTIONS_ACCEPTED | PREVIEW_WITHOUT_SUGGESTIONS.

configurationParameters.label: Documentid
configurationParameters.description: Request field for operations that declare `documentId` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

configurationParameters.label: Include tabs
configurationParameters.description: documents.get includeTabsContent. get. true returns all tab contents.

configurationParameters.label: Requests
configurationParameters.description: Request field for operations that declare `requests` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
